nodes.label: Current frontend PMS demo
nodes.rationale: Operates without backend participation; hotel selector is illustrative and does not isolate hotel data.

nodes.label: Planned SaaS PMS architecture
nodes.rationale: Design targets a mid-December 2026 launch; planned capabilities must not be read as current implementation.

nodes.label: Demo check-in and check-out rules
nodes.rationale: Check-in requires confirmed booking, correct stay date and clean room; check-out dirties the room and cleaning updates room views.

nodes.label: Demo half-open stay intervals
nodes.rationale: Overlap is prohibited for [check_in, check_out), allowing same-day checkout and next check-in.

nodes.label: Demo occupancy calculation
nodes.rationale: Daily occupancy is computed from confirmed and in-house bookings.

nodes.label: Demo projected room revenue
nodes.rationale: Booking value is allocated evenly by night; this is not an actual accounting or payment report.

nodes.label: Demo shared booking state
nodes.rationale: One booking dataset feeds reservations, Tape Chart, room diagram, housekeeping, four dashboard room indicators and reports.

nodes.label: Planned Channex-style Channel Manager integration
nodes.rationale: One intermediary integration avoids lengthy direct OTA access, reduces integration effort and supports two-way rates and inventory sync.

nodes.label: Planned room_type_availabilities daily inventory
nodes.rationale: Incremental booked and blocked counts avoid scanning reservations whenever Tape Chart loads; available_to_sell equals total_rooms minus booked_count minus blocked_count.

nodes.label: Planned booking exchange-rate snapshot
nodes.rationale: Freeze transaction exchange rates so later currency movements cannot change historical invoices or revenue.

nodes.label: Planned Expand and Contract migrations
nodes.rationale: Do not rename or drop an actively used column/table in one deployment; staged change and transactional DDL preserve data and uptime.

nodes.label: Planned feature gating and trial mode
nodes.norm_label: planned feature gating and trial mode
nodes.rationale: Display locked advanced features to trial users to encourage upgrades; backend middleware enforces feature access with HTTP 403.

nodes.label: Planned separate Internal Admin
nodes.rationale: Separate source and subdomain reduce exposure of administration flows in the hotel app.

nodes.label: Planned Phase 2 mobile app
nodes.rationale: Reuse JSON REST API while designing mobile-specific owner and housekeeping workflows; add device_tokens for push notifications.

nodes.label: Planned precise monetary storage
nodes.rationale: Use DECIMAL/NUMERIC or minor-unit BIGINT instead of FLOAT/REAL to avoid rounding errors.

nodes.label: Planned notification dispatch pipeline
nodes.rationale: Resolve per-tenant channels, recipient roles and realtime/hourly/daily delivery settings; in-app is mandatory and mobile push is Phase 2.

nodes.label: Planned Point-in-Time Recovery
nodes.rationale: Restore data to a specific historical time after accidental deletion or disaster.

nodes.label: Planned global and tenant RBAC
nodes.rationale: Separate global administrative authority from hotel-specific owner, front-desk, housekeeping and accountant roles.

nodes.label: Planned PostgreSQL read/write replicas
nodes.rationale: Route reads and reports to replica and mutations to master so expensive reporting does not interrupt booking and check-in.

nodes.label: Planned Redis caching sessions and rate limiting
nodes.norm_label: planned redis caching sessions and rate limiting
nodes.rationale: Cache tenant Tape Chart snapshots, invalidate after booking changes, write through ARI changes, store expiring token blacklists and limit requests.

nodes.label: Planned PostgreSQL Row Level Security
nodes.rationale: Prevent one hotel's data from being visible to another hotel.

nodes.label: Planned single database single schema tenancy
nodes.norm_label: planned single database single schema tenancy
nodes.rationale: Tenant IDs permit simpler management, aggregate reporting and migration than thousands of separate schemas.

nodes.label: Planned tenant_features entitlements
nodes.rationale: Separate per-hotel enabled state from package defaults so individual overrides survive upgrades; merge new features without removing old ones.

nodes.label: Planned warehouse item supplier and opening-stock master data
nodes.norm_label: planned warehouse item supplier and opening-stock master data
nodes.rationale: Opening stock is entered once at setup; later stock is computed from receipts and issues.
